decision_conditions:
<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="2" type="1">
 </ol><p>The
     proposal, by reason of the site being located within an area of land
     liable to flooding and the lack of a comprehensive Flood Risk Assessment,
     due to a lack of&nbsp;flood mitigation measures which take into account
     the compensatory flood storage details, has failed to demonstrate that the
     proposed development would not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the
     site or increase the risk and consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary
     to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies SI12 and SI13 of
     The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of Harrow Core Strategy (2012)
     and Policies DM 9 and DM 10 of the Harrow Development Management Polices
     Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="2" type="1">
</ol>
